This assignment has two main parts. Part 1 loads and inspects TCGA transcriptomic data and extracts clinical, gene-annotation, and expression tables. Part 2 uses those tables for differential-expression analysis.

## Deliverables

- This completed R notebook.
- A descriptively named volcano plot in the same `week7_transcriptomics` folder.

## Part 1

### Setup

The analysis directory can be supplied through the `QBIO490_ANALYSIS_DIR` environment variable. If it is not supplied, the notebook uses an `analysis_data` directory in the user's home directory.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
notebook_path <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
output_dir <- if (nzchar(notebook_path)) dirname(notebook_path) else getwd()

analysis_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "QBIO490_ANALYSIS_DIR",
  unset = file.path(path.expand("~"), "analysis_data")
)
dir.create(analysis_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(analysis_dir, mustWork = TRUE))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r package-setup}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

needed <- c("TCGAbiolinks", "SummarizedExperiment", "DESeq2", "EnhancedVolcano")
missing <- needed[!vapply(needed, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing) > 0) BiocManager::install(missing, ask = FALSE)

library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```

### Load the RNA-seq data

```{r load-rna-se}
rna_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts"
)

# Download the open-access files before preparing the SummarizedExperiment.
GDCdownload(rna_query, directory = analysis_dir, files.per.chunk = 20)
rna_se <- GDCprepare(rna_query, directory = analysis_dir)
```

### 1. SummarizedExperiment basics

```{r exercise-1-1}
head(rna_se)
str(rna_se)
```

```{r exercise-1-2}
dim(colData(rna_se))
dim(rowData(rna_se))
dim(assay(rna_se, "unstranded"))
```

For the Fall 2026 snapshot used for this assignment, the dimensions are:

- `colData`: 1,231 rows by 94 columns.
- `rowData`: 60,660 rows by 10 columns.
- `unstranded`: 60,660 rows by 1,231 columns.

The rows of `colData` are TCGA sample barcodes and its columns are clinical/sample metadata variables. The rows of `rowData` are genes and its columns are gene annotations. In the unstranded assay, rows are genes and columns are TCGA samples.

```{r exercise-1-3}
rownames(colData(rna_se))
colnames(colData(rna_se))

rownames(rowData(rna_se))
colnames(rowData(rna_se))

rownames(assay(rna_se, "unstranded"))
colnames(assay(rna_se, "unstranded"))
```

## Part 2

### 1. Read the saved tables

```{r part-2-read-data}
rna_clinical <- read.csv(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_rna_clinical_data.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
rna_genes <- read.csv(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_rna_gene_data.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
rna_counts <- read.csv(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_rna_count_data.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

### 2. Prepare the model variables and filter genes

I control for age as a continuous covariate. I do not include PAM50 subtype because the normal samples generally do not have a tumor-intrinsic PAM50 subtype; coding those missing values as a level would make subtype strongly confounded with sample definition.

```{r part-2-prepare}
valid_definition <- rna_clinical$definition %in% c(
  "Primary solid Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal"
)
valid_age <- !is.na(rna_clinical$age_at_index)
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[valid_definition & valid_age, , drop = FALSE]

# Keep only samples present in both data objects, and place them in the same order.
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_counts), rownames(rna_clinical))
rna_counts <- rna_counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(rna_counts), rownames(rna_clinical)))

rna_clinical$age_at_index <- as.numeric(rna_clinical$age_at_index)
rna_clinical$definition <- relevel(
  factor(rna_clinical$definition),
  ref = "Solid Tissue Normal"
)

# Keep genes whose total count across all retained samples is at least 1,000.
keep_genes <- rowSums(rna_counts, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1000
rna_counts <- rna_counts[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
rna_genes <- rna_genes[match(rownames(rna_counts), rna_genes$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]

table(rna_clinical$definition)
summary(rna_clinical$age_at_index)
dim(rna_counts)
```

### 3. Differential-expression analysis

```{r part-2-deseq2}
library(DESeq2)

count_matrix <- as.matrix(rna_counts)
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = rna_clinical,
  design = ~ age_at_index + definition
)

dds_obj <- DESeq(dds)
resultsNames(dds_obj)

results <- results(
  dds_obj,
  format = "DataFrame",
  contrast = c("definition", "Primary solid Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal")
)
results <- as.data.frame(results)

write.csv(
  results,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_DESeq_results.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)
saveRDS(results, file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_DESeq_results.rds"))
```

```{r part-2-annotate-results}
results$gene_name <- rna_genes$gene_name[
  match(rownames(results), rna_genes$gene_id)
]
```

### 4. Volcano plot

```{r part-2-volcano, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

volcano_plot <- EnhancedVolcano(
  results,
  lab = results$gene_name,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",
  title = "TCGA-BRCA: Primary Tumor vs Normal Tissue",
  subtitle = "DESeq2 model adjusted for age at index",
  pointSize = 1.0,
  labSize = 4.0,
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1.0,
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.4
)

volcano_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "TCGA_BRCA_tumor_vs_normal_volcano.png"),
  plot = volcano_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "TCGA_BRCA_tumor_vs_normal_volcano.svg"),
  plot = volcano_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)
```

### 5. Interpretation

- **Top-right genes:** statistically significant and upregulated in primary tumor relative to normal tissue; they have positive log2 fold changes and small adjusted p-values.
- **Bottom-right genes:** higher estimated expression in tumor, but not statistically significant after multiple-testing correction.
- **Top-left genes:** statistically significant and downregulated in primary tumor relative to normal tissue; they have negative log2 fold changes and small adjusted p-values.
- **Bottom-left genes:** lower estimated expression in tumor, but not statistically significant after multiple-testing correction.
- **Top-middle genes:** statistically significant but with small fold changes, so the evidence for a difference is strong even though the estimated effect size is modest.
- **Bottom-middle genes:** neither statistically significant nor meaningfully changed in magnitude.

Positive fold change is defined by the specified contrast, `Primary solid Tumor / Solid Tissue Normal`; reversing the contrast would reverse the left/right interpretation.
